goal: Add JavaScript, then TypeScript/TSX, as first-class backends in the existing Rust core (scanner backend + IR emission + PERF-JS rules + additive schema language values + fixtures/goldens), without rewriting the analyzer or reporter.
current_phase: B2-W0 DONE (pins + link tests + canary; panel R1-R5/Q1-Q2 APPROVED); B2-W1 next. Frozen: 11 ship / 1 cut (LOOP-003).

decisions.title: PARSER: tree-sitter-javascript =0.25.0 (ABI 15) + tree-sitter-typescript =0.23.2 (ABI 14) on tree-sitter =0.26.13; MIT, C11 only. oxc/swc rejected (MSRV/churn). ADR-0011.
LANGUAGE TOKENS: js / ts / tsx follow the grammar boundary. .jsx -> js; .ts/.mts/.cts -> ts; .tsx -> tsx; .d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts skipped. Longest-suffix-first detection.

SCHEMA: ONE minor bump v1.7->v1.8 in B2, all three tokens up front; no required list grows; src/docs artifacts byte-identical; v1.7 retained; CLI suffix + $id/title/desc/const/enums rewritten; goldens regenerate once.
ANALYZER FAMILY: JS and TS/TSX share PERF-JS-* (same V8/Node mechanism); RuleLanguage::Js matches js|ts|tsx; RuleLanguage::Ts reserved for TS-only constructs (none in v1 unless canary proves one).
RULE CATALOG: 12 candidates frozen by the B2-W0 canary -> 11 ship, LOOP-003 cut (no array RHS); ALLOC-001 reframed (invariance gate), CALL-001 guard-gated. Evidence docs/evidence/js-canary.md.
DISCOVERY: skip vendored/minified JS; 2 MiB cap (corrected by D-tb-009). No skip counters in v1.8.
TIER: syntactic only. No semantic resolver claim, no libclang, no semantic-clang feature change. Reachability stays resolved-edge-only.
B1 SCOPE: planning only; no production code, no dependency added, no schema change, no main-state/Atlas edits.
DISCOVERY: directory skips GLOBAL (node_modules, bower_components, dist, build, out, coverage); file skips (*.min.*, *.bundle.js, >2 MiB) JS/TS-only; vendor kept; existing corpora unaffected.
STAGED FALLBACK: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = [c,js,python,rust] in B2, adds ts/tsx in B3; v1.8 enum admits all six from the start.

REPORTER CATALOG (B-tb-003): HEURISTIC_CATALOG_V1 (A-owned) count/equality asserts + panics; catalog + B2 registry land together; A supplies or founder approves a catalog-only B edit in B2-W2. 11 entries.

CANARY FREEZE (B2-W0): 11 of 12 ship; LOOP-003 cut (0 array RHS); ALLOC-001 reframed (invariance gate), CALL-001 guard-gated. Pins compile on 1.92, deny green, 6 link tests. Evidence docs/evidence/js-canary.md.

open_risks.title: Grammar crates declare no rust-version; both compile on 1.92 (B2-W0), fallback 0.23.1 not needed.
TS grammar is ABI 14 (JS 15) - inside the window but one generation behind; exact pin + node-types diff on upgrade (ADR-0001 G5).
TS/TSX node names drift across grammar releases; pin + in-repo queries + parser snapshot tests.
Vendored/minified JS would dominate findings and stall scans; mitigated by global directory skips + JS/TS-only file/size cap.
Precision ratchet hard for JS idioms; mitigated by B2-W0 freeze (11 rules, gates) + per-rule FP class.
No type information -> type-aware rules impossible; syntactic tier stated honestly and limitations published.
Build time/binary size grows by two C parsers; accepted, no feature gate.
Global directory skips change C/Rust/Python discovery where those dirs exist; corpora contain none; documented, criterion 6 restated.
Reporter HEURISTIC_CATALOG_V1 is A-owned but required (67-count/panic tests); blocker B-tb-003.
TSX vs generic-arrow ambiguity (<T,>) degrades parse health; record degradation honestly, do not score unparsed regions, add .tsx snapshot tests.
CJS/ESM kind not inferred; entry detection mixes require.main/import.meta; documented; candidates sorted/deduped.
.d.ts skip hides type-only modules (imports become unresolved-internal data-only); unlabeled minified <2 MiB still parsed; extensions case-sensitive.
Malformed/unreadable package.json must be per-file data (ignore + fall back to scan root), never a panic/exit 3.
Pinned TS grammar 0.23.2 cannot parse f<typeof import("x")>() (220/229 gemini-cli parse failures); degrade honestly, upgrade only via ADR-0001 G5 node-types review.

blocked_by.title: views.rs / reporter mod.rs language wiring is A-owned until A step 12; B rebases and wires only after.
Merge to main requires A step 12 + explicit founder approval; beta is Track A and must not be delayed.
HEURISTIC_CATALOG_V1 entries (src/reporter/mod.rs) must be landed by Track A before B2, or the founder must approve a catalog-only B edit; B2 cannot ship a rule without them.
